x-download-policy.behavior: Each GET artifacts issues fresh authorized URLs, expiring at issued_at+300s. It preserves job and artifact identities/bytes and performs no export. Inline GET job manifests are snapshots; requery artifacts before downloading or after expiry. JSON bytes may vary.

x-initial-flow.description: UI adds initial revision request without a new screen or confirmation; jobs require that existing revision_id

x-semantic-invariants: Pydantic validators additionally enforce cross-field references, stage transitions, issue classification and digital/physical separation.
H1 enforces authorization, immutable revisions, profile resolution, idempotency, real artifact existence and worker observations.
No provider switch to cloud after local provider failure; preserve selected provider and diagnostic.

x-upload-limits.enforcement: H1 must configure and enforce before parsing/processing
